_comment: Every supported field, with placeholder values. Copy the parts you need into storefront.json. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by scripts/build.py. Field reference: docs/CUSTOMIZING.md.

site._comment: url is required: the exact public address of the page, https and ending in /.
site.name: Your Product Name

seo._comment: title and description are required. social_* default to title/description. image is relative to site.url or absolute.
seo.title: Your Product Name | One-line benefit
seo.description: One clear sentence about what the buyer gets.
seo.social_description: A shorter sentence for link previews.
seo.image_alt: Describe what the social card image shows.

hero._comment: heading is required and becomes the page's only <h1>. background_image is decorative (no alt text needed).
hero.heading: Your Product Name
hero.lead: Say exactly what the buyer gets, who it helps, and what happens after payment.

product._comment: Builds the Product/Offer JSON-LD. name, description, every offer name/description and price must also be visible on the page; scripts/check_site.py enforces it. Offers render where a section has include: offers.
product.name: Your Product Name
product.description: Say exactly what the buyer gets, who it helps, and what happens after payment.

offers._comment: price is a plain number string; currency is an ISO 4217 code. price_label overrides the visible price text (default: $19, Free, or 19 CAD).
offers.name: Standard
offers.description: ZIP download with the template, checklist, and setup notes.

offers._comment: item_type marks what is sold when it is not the product itself, e.g. Service.
offers.name: Setup help
offers.description: One setup session by email after purchase.

sections._comment: heading is required. id defaults to a slug of the heading and is the #anchor. Every other field is optional and renders in this order: paragraphs, list, columns, code, actions, links.
sections.heading: What You Get
paragraphs: A short paragraph about the deliverable.

sections.heading: Try It
paragraphs: Show a command, then link to the sample.

sections._comment: include: offers renders the product.offers cards here. Without it they are appended at the end under Pricing.
sections.heading: Pricing
Delivery And Support
paragraphs: After payment, the buyer receives a ZIP or store download. Support email: you@example.com.
Refund support: 14-day refund if the ZIP cannot be opened or listed files are missing.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: Say what this is not for. Do not request private credentials or payment details in public.

sections._comment: include: faq renders the faq list here and builds FAQPage JSON-LD. Leave faq empty to omit both.
sections.heading: Questions

faq.question: What format is the download?
faq.answer: A ZIP file with a README.

footer.text: Plain text line without a link.
